page.overview:
Who is David Brabham?

David Brabham (born September 5, 1965 in Wimbledon, United Kingdom) is a British-born Australian racing driver, the youngest son of three-time World Champion Jack Brabham. His brother Gary Brabham also raced in Formula One for the unsuccessful team in , the same year as David's F1 debut. Another brother, Geoff, did not race in F1. In 2009, Brabham won the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

He first drove for his father's team, in 1990, and then for in 1994.

Brabham is married to Lisa Thackwell, the sister of Mike Thackwell. Their son, Sam Brabham, is also a racing driver, who's competed in the British Formula Ford series.
